Resolves #20372

Related: #20370

Adds `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs` and wires `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` (`hasBrainRuntimeRoot` + `runDedicatedWorkerNeuralLink`) so the `neuralLink` fixture dispatches directly to the page's captured dedicated App Worker (`Neo.ai.Client#handleTestRequest`) with no Brain checkout and zero WebSockets when `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` is unset, while preserving the Bridge path unchanged when `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` is set.

`change-class: capability -> feat`; `agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit + e2e jobs ran`.

Evidence: L3 (live Playwright browser + dedicated App Worker E2E + unit suites) → L3 required (AC-1..5).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/e2e/core/DedicatedWorkerAdapter.spec.mjs` (`reads and writes against a real source app on a dedicated worker and opens zero WebSockets`: `2 passed` with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` unset; CDP `Network.webSocketCreated === []` and `Neo.ai.Client.socket === null`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/test/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.spec.mjs` (`each test receives its own writer pair and teardown calls handleAgentDisconnected even when use() throws`) + `test/playwright/e2e/core/DedicatedWorkerAdapter.spec.mjs` (`mints a fresh writer pair per test and ends it through handleAgentDisconnected when a test throws`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs` (`connectToApp` evaluates only the page's captured `/worker/App.mjs` `Worker` handle, verified with `connectToApp('UnrelatedTargetNameNeverSearchedByAppName')` in unit and E2E specs) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/test/findBridgeScriptRoot.spec.mjs`, `startNeuralLinkConnection.spec.mjs`, `stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs` + live Bridge E2E run of `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ButtonBaseNL.spec.mjs` (`4 passed` with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set) |
| AC-5 | `learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md` (`3. Choose the Dispatch Path (Dedicated-Worker Adapter vs. Bridge)` and `## Connecting the Neural Link (Fixtures)`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- In `createDedicatedWorkerAppConnection#getWindowTopology`, falls back to `Object.entries(Neo.apps)` when `Neo.manager.Window.items` is empty on a dedicated App Worker (matching `Neo.ai.Client#onSocketOpen`'s dedicated-worker window registration).

## Test Evidence
- `env -u NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/core/DedicatedWorkerAdapter.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs` → `2 passed (9.7s)` (verified against `/examples/button/base/index.html` with `Network.webSocketCreated === []` and `Neo.ai.Client.socket === null`).
- `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=/Users/tobiasuhlig/.neo-ai/agents/neo-gemini-maryam/neomjs/neo-agent-brain NEO_NL_PORT=18947 npx playwright test test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ButtonBaseNL.spec.mjs -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs` → `4 passed (12.8s)`.
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/test/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/test/findBridgeScriptRoot.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/test/startNeuralLinkConnection.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/test/externalBrainSelection.spec.mjs` → `30 passed (562ms)`.

### 📋 Required Actions

To proceed with merging, please address the following:

- [ ] **RA-1: One `nlApp` surface, two transports.** The 49 methods in `createDedicatedWorkerAppConnection` and the Bridge wrappers in `fixtures.mjs#connectToApp` must come from one definition, so a method added once exists on both paths with the same argument shaping and the same response pick.
  - Your adapter already writes each method as `call(tool, params)` plus a pick. That is the table to keep, in one shared module under `test/playwright/`.
  - Every Bridge wrapper calls `NeuralLink_<Service>Service[camelCase(tool)]({sessionId, ...params})` (e.g. `callMethod` → `InstanceService.callMethod`). A Bridge `call(tool, params)` can therefore drive the same table, and the 49 hand-written wrappers go.
  - The Bridge path's behaviour must not change: the Brain-tier shards at the new head are the witness. A unit arm that builds both surfaces over stub transports and asserts the same method set closes it.
